description.zh: 存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数（可选值：60、90、180、365）。0表示不归档保存。
description.en: The number of days for automatic archiving after storage expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. A value of 0 indicates no archiving.

description.zh: 是否开启免密读的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔。
description.en: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free read. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds.

description.zh: 是否开启免密写的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔。
description.en: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free write. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds.
Specifies whether to enable authentication-free read.
Specifies whether to enable authentication-free write.
Specifies whether to enable access token authentication.

description.zh:
计费方式：
POSTPAY：按指标上报量后付费。
POSTPAY_GB：按指标写入量后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:
- POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go based on metric reporting volume.
- POSTPAY_GB: Pay-as-you-go based on metric write volume.
The resource group ID of the Prometheus instance.
The data retention period, in days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-prometheus-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --cluster-id vpc-xxx --storage-duration 90 --archive-duration 90 --enable-auth-token true --enable-auth-free-read true --auth-free-read-policy 0.0.0.0/0 --enable-auth-free-write true --auth-free-write-policy 0.0.0.0/0 --payment-type POSTPAY --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UpdatePrometheusInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ArchiveDuration 90 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxyexli20000' --ClusterId 'vpc-xxx' --PaymentType POSTPAY --EnableAuthToken true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AuthFreeReadPolicy '0.0.0.0/0' --StorageDuration 90 --AuthFreeWritePolicy '0.0.0.0/0' --EnableAuthFreeRead true --EnableAuthFreeWrite true
